description: The classic rule: Turing-complete, with gliders, guns and oscillators.
name: Conway's Game of Life

description: Life plus birth on 6 neighbours; has a small self-replicating pattern.
name: HighLife

description: Symmetric under swapping live and dead cells (self-dual).
name: Day & Night

description: Every live cell dies each step; patterns explode outwards.
name: Seeds

description: Live cells never die, so patterns only grow, producing ladders.
name: Life without Death

description: Odd neighbour counts only; every pattern copies itself (linear over GF(2)).
name: Replicator

description: Grows labyrinth-like walls from a random start.
name: Maze

description: Maze variant that produces longer, straighter corridors.
name: Mazectric

description: Slow-growing, coral-like branching structures.
name: Coral

description: Rule where 2x2 blocks play the role of stable building blocks.
name: 2x2

description: Life variant, famous for being unstable and explosive.
name: 34 Life

description: No cell survives; patterns grow as intricate lace-like fabrics.
name: Serviettes

description: Life's birth rule with survival on only one or two neighbours.
name: Flock

description: The dual of Life (live and dead swapped); a B0 rule, so it strobes.
name: Anti-Life

description: Forms diamond-shaped amoeba-like blobs.
name: Diamoeba

description: Also called Move; supports many spaceships and puffers.
name: Morley

description: Smooths noisy regions into blobs, like annealing.
name: Anneal

description: Birth and survival both on exactly one neighbour; a single cell grows an intricate, gnarled pattern.
name: Gnarl

description: Has very long-period oscillators.
name: Long Life

description: Amoeba-like blobs that wander and merge.
name: Amoeba

description: Smooth, blob-forming rule where structures absorb their neighbours.
name: Assimilation

description: Chaotic rule that coagulates into thick, solid clumps.
name: Coagulations

description: Grows walled, city-like enclosures.
name: Walled Cities

description: Stable stain-like regions spread across the grid.
name: Stains

description: Life variant where isolated live cells also survive.
name: DotLife

description: Behaves much like Life without being Life.
name: Pseudo Life

description: Lone cells survive and 2-neighbour cells are born; supports gliders.
name: Live Free or Die
